_about: The renderer prototype's defaults, copied from the design doc (Prototype > Parameters and defaults) and the prototype's constants. UNTUNED PLACEHOLDERS: tuning is carried over to the first variant board (design doc, Decision workflow > Carried over). Code reads these; none of them is a decision until a variant board makes it one and data/decisions/decisions.json records it.

source.design_doc: Prototype > Parameters and defaults; Style rules > Palette

brush_size.affects: Brush radius; enclosure size = 2.6 x brush

collision_check.affects: Rejects overlaps; clears sites under structures

tree_height.affects: Height as a multiple of radius

sun_direction.affects: Shadow direction, roof and slope shading; 315 = NW

line_weight.affects: All ink; per-element multipliers are under linework

aircraft_shadow_altitude_scale.affects: A plane's shadow is cast as if it flew at altitude x this (600 m up casts like 6 m), so the gap grows with height and closes near the ground

render_passes._about: Draw order, bottom to top, and the prototype's default toggles.

accents._about: Side colours (Alex 2026-10-09, decision unit-sheet-choices). Equal OKLCH lightness and chroma: side_a oklch(0.551 0.100 30), side_b oklch(0.551 0.100 260). One accent zone per unit: wing roundels, the tank's engine-deck panel, the battery's ground panel, the cruiser's quarterdeck, the radio hut roof. Alex: worth mirroring in the HUD.

linework._about: Style rules > Linework: multipliers on line_weight per element.

pen._about: How an ink line's width varies along it (Alex 2026-10-09, decision pen-line, option C 'shadow side'): a closed outline is thin on edges facing the sun and heavy on edges facing away; open lines are a fixed fraction with tapered ends. Width = line weight x element multiplier x these factors. prototype_default is the prototype's even line, used by --parity.

detail_light._about: Fixed top-left light for interior detail (florets, stipple), independent of the sun. A prototype choice, not read from the reference.
